lines.beaver_en: I came to visit you. Are you feeling okay?
lines.learner: 와 줘서 고마워요. 병실에 혼자 있어서 심심했어요.
lines.en: Thanks for coming. I was bored alone in the hospital room.
lines.roman: wa jwoseo gomawoyo. byeongsire honja isseoseo simsimhaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Where did it hurt at first?
lines.en: I hurt my head when I fell on the street.

lines.beaver_en: Really? So did you go to the ER?
lines.learner: 네, 응급실에 갔을 때 피가 많이 났어요.
lines.en: Yes, I was bleeding a lot when I got to the ER.
lines.roman: ne, eunggeupsire gasseul ttae piga mani nasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: You must have been scared. Did you see a doctor?
lines.en: Yes, I got examined and they put on disinfectant.

lines.beaver_en: What about the wound? Did you get a bandage?
lines.learner: 네, 반창고를 붙였어요. 상처는 크지 않아요.
lines.en: Yes, I put on a bandage. The wound isn't big.
lines.roman: ne, banchanggoreul buchyeosseoyo. sangcheoneun keuji anayo.

lines.beaver_en: That's a relief. What medicine did you get?
lines.en: I was prescribed headache medicine and painkillers.

lines.beaver: 밤에는 잘 자요? 아프면 잠이 안 오잖아요.
lines.beaver_en: Do you sleep well? It's hard to sleep when you hurt.
lines.beaver_roman: bameneun jal jayo? apeumyeon jami an ojanayo.
lines.learner: 잠이 안 왔을 때 수면제도 먹었어요.
lines.en: When I couldn't sleep, I took a sleeping pill.
lines.roman: jami an wasseul ttae sumyeonjedo meogeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Is there any other treatment besides medicine?
lines.en: Yes, I also use an ice pack. It feels really cool.

lines.beaver_en: Did you go to the hospital often as a kid too?
lines.learner: 네, 어렸을 때 소아과에서 물약을 자주 받았어요.
lines.en: Yes, when I was little, I often got liquid medicine at pediatrics.
lines.roman: ne, eoryeosseul ttae soagwaeseo mullyageul jaju badasseoyo.

lines.beaver: 하하, 그랬군요. 푹 쉬고 빨리 나아요!
lines.beaver_en: Haha, I see. Rest well and get better soon!
lines.beaver_roman: haha, geuraetgunnyo. puk swigo ppalli naayo!
lines.learner: 고마워요. 퇴원하면 처방전 들고 약국 갈게요.
lines.en: Thanks. When I'm discharged, I'll take my prescription to the pharmacy.
lines.roman: gomawoyo. toewonhamyeon cheobangjeon deulgo yakguk galgeyo.
